items.a: It means you place your order days in advance, and we prepare it fresh from the farm and deliver it on the delivery day. No payment now — you pay on delivery.
Currently we deliver in Gharbia. Expansion to Alexandria, Cairo, and Giza is coming soon.
Delivery is on Thursday and Friday. You can choose your preferred day when ordering.
Cash on delivery. No online payment at this time.

items.q: How long do the products stay fresh?
items.a: Each product has storage notes if available. Generally, bread is best eaten the same day or frozen, and cheese and butter should be refrigerated.
Use the WhatsApp button on the page, or message us on our Facebook page.
